sources.role: pinned source for Linux .arnold grammar, Windows registry settings, media and snapshot behavior
official Linux usage and resource documentation

paths.naming: Plain key=value lines; supported keys include romdir, diskdir, tapedir, cartdir, snapdir, drivea, driveb, cart, tape, rom0..rom15 and monitor settings

paths.path: No persistent joystick/key binding file is implemented by the pinned Unix port; SDL keyboard mapping and joystick enumeration are runtime state
paths.naming: No authorable native binding grammar established

paths.path: User-selected .dsk disk images and .tzx/.cdt tape images; guest files are stored in attached media
User-selected snapshot filename passed to -snapshot or GTK save chooser
paths.naming: .sna Amstrad snapshot; version 3 is written by default

paths.path: ROMs are linked from the source roms/ tree and the Unix executable expects a roms/ subdirectory beside it; expansion ROMs may be listed as rom0..rom15 in .arnold
paths.naming: Built-in model ROMs include CPC464/664/6128 OS+Basic, CPC+ cartridge and KC Compact assets; no universal firmware checksum asserted
Not applicable to this CPC emulator

Registry values include iCRTCType, iRealtime, iWarnReset, iWarnExit, iMonitorType, iMonitorBrightness, iFrameSkip, sCartridgePath, sDiskImagePath, sSnapshotPath, sTapePath, sDriveADiskImage, sDriveBDiskImage, sRomPath and expansion-ROM entries

paths.path: Windows registry settings plus runtime joystick enumeration
paths.naming: Pinned source persists emulator settings but does not establish a stable physical controller-id grammar

paths.path: User-selected .dsk/.tzx/.cdt/.cpr media; guest files remain in attached images
User-selected snapshot path, with last path persisted as registry value sSnapshotPath
paths.naming: .sna snapshot, version 3 default; no numbered slot grammar established

paths.path: Application ROM/resource tree and user-selected expansion ROM paths in the Arnold registry key
paths.naming: Model ROM names are source resource names; no universal checksum asserted

linux-flatpak.reason: Pinned upstream provides Unix source but no verified Flatpak app id
